news.headline: Curaleaf Enhances Offer to Acquire Aurora Cannabis in Takeover Bid
news.summary: Curaleaf said on October 5 that it will raise its offer for Aurora Cannabis by about 25% to an implied US$5 per share. It also raised the maximum value per share from US$5 to US$6. Curaleaf is one of Florida's largest medical cannabis operators, so a successful deal could change its corporate footing, though the article does not describe any direct change to Florida patient access or pricing.
